title: Chapter 35
text: hat slap snapped me out a reverie I had been living in for hundreds of years. It obliterated any grace I had left to give you, any lies I was still telling myself about your good intentions and your savior’s heart. I had always comforted myself in the dark hours after any of our arguments with the thought that at least you had never hurt any of us. You would never hurt any of us. You only wanted what was best for us, and you were harsh with us because you loved us. But now, all my carefully crafted excuses for you dissolved like sugar under absinthe, revealing a truth I had spent centuries avoiding.
